title: Cover and remove a chafing fuel holder from under a buffet stand
instruction: Swing the snuffer cover shut over the chafing fuel holder under the stand, then remove the covered fuel holder and set it in the stainless bussing pan.
context: Banquet, catering, and restaurant staff cap chafing-fuel holders under wire chafer stands before breakdown, holding the loose burner handle steady while swinging the horizontal snuffer plate closed so it clears the front legs on withdrawal.
setup: Three objects on the station table representing a cold 1:1 commercial 8-quart buffet wire chafer breakdown setup (evaluated cold and unlit). (1) Fixed stainless chafer stand frame at x=345 mm, y=0 mm (240 x 228 mm rolled upper water-pan deck with underside at z=204 mm above the table, four 8 x 8 mm corner leg uprights leaving a 144 mm clear front opening between the front legs and a 188 mm clear side opening, and a lower central burner support ring of 98 mm inner width and 28 mm rim height centred at x=345 mm, y=0 mm, floor z=12 mm). (2) Loose stainless chafing fuel holder assembly (257 g total, seated upright inside the lower burner ring at x=345 mm, y=0 mm): a 90 x 90 x 60 mm burner cup holding a spent cold steel fuel tin with top wick boss, an 85 x 30 x 8 mm flat front handle stem extending forward along -X with a 32 x 30 x 26 mm insulated grip neck and 42 mm flared finger-guard end-butt at x=209 mm, and a top-pivoted horizontal snuffer damper plate (94 x 94 x 6 mm with an upright turned brass knob of 18 mm stem diameter, 49 mm stem height, and 28 x 6 mm flared top cap, hinge anchor on the front-right rim, 0.010 N m hinge friction, starting swung 110 degrees open to -Y so the assembly's minimum horizontal caliper width across all 0..360 deg yaw angles is 168.7 mm > 144.0 mm clear front leg gap, narrowing to 99.0 mm Y-width once closed concentric). (3) Fixed stainless bussing pan (220 x 176 x 34 mm, 5 mm walls/floor, 210 x 166 mm inner cavity) at x=280 mm, y=+235 mm.
scoring: Any latched hazard permanently scores 0: the fuel holder leaves the burner ring (>25 mm radial offset from x=345 mm, y=0 mm) before the snuffer cover has closed within 15 degrees of concentric, the fuel holder tilts over 35 degrees from vertical (spilling liquid wick fuel), or any physical corner of the fuel holder strikes the station tabletop or floor with a pre-impact downward speed exceeding 0.50 m/s; gentle upright placement of the snuffed holder on the table at 0.50 m/s or less does not penalize the trial. Every positive score requires the snuffer cover closed within 8 degrees of concentric (0 degrees), independent support, all four fingertips >=80 mm from every collider surface of the fuel holder, chafer stand, and bussing pan, and <1 mm 3D Euclidean extremal-point movement across the fuel holder and snuffer cover over the final 1.0 s (21 samples at 20 Hz). 0.40: covered fuel holder resting upright within 5 degrees inside the burner support ring (within 12 mm of x=345 mm, y=0 mm) with the snuffer cover closed within 8 degrees. 1.0: covered fuel holder resting upright within 5 degrees wholly inside the 210 x 166 mm inner cavity of the stainless bussing pan (lowest corner within 8 mm of the pan floor) with the snuffer cover closed within 8 degrees.
reset_notes: Swing the fuel holder's snuffer cover 110 degrees open toward -Y and seat the fuel holder upright inside the chafer stand's central burner ring with its handle pointing forward (-X).
fidelity: Evaluated cold and unlit (no flame or heat simulated). Rigid PhysX box/cylinder colliders (6-8 mm wall proxies for thin stamped stainless sheet, 257 g total holder mass) use an 18 mm torsional patch radius (10 mm min). The articulated snuffer damper has 0.010 N m friction, 0.02 N m s/rad damping, and sibling collision; at 110 deg open its 168.7 mm minimum span blocks on the 144 mm front legs, and unbraced knob pushes spin the loose cup.
